summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture and one parametrized test covering all valid forms, each error branch, non-node inputs, and an unchanged-graph check. All 42 tests pass (new module plus existing test/test_path.py, unmodified). Nothing committed. black, isort, and mypy are not installed in the shared venv, so they were not run; line lengths were checked by hand.
